nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Hi! Yes, I'm your new bartender! Come to my place if you want to drink something.

nodes.speaker: carrot_top
nodes.text: I'll come, of course. Especially if you buy something from me.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Good trade. How much would you be willing to pay for what I make from your ingredients?

nodes.speaker: carrot_top
nodes.text: Let me think... You'll need something to grind it with...

nodes.speaker: carrot_top
nodes.text: I'm willing to pay 2-3 times more than you'd give me for one carrot..
